record.dic_text:
03284 ya`anah {ya-a-na:'}

源自 03283; TWOT - 884b; 陰性名詞

欽定本 - owl 8; 8

1) 不潔淨的鳥
   1a) 貓頭鷹, 鴕鳥, 照字面翻譯為"貓頭鷹的女兒"
   1b) 可能是一種絕種鳥類, 確切意義不明
record.edic_text:
03284 ya`anah {yah-an-aw'}

from 03283; TWOT - 884b; n f

AV - owl 8; 8

1) an unclean bird
   1a) owl, ostrich, literally translated as "daughters of the owl"
   1b) perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown
